run_cmd_init: run the autoresearch CLI init command to set up a new experiment workdir
run_cmd_assess: run the autoresearch CLI assess command to evaluate a baseline job against the workdir
run_cmd_status: run the autoresearch CLI status command to check the current state of an experiment workdir
run_cmd_queue: run the autoresearch CLI queue command to list, remove, or prioritize jobs in the workdir
run_cmd_report: run the autoresearch CLI report command to generate a summary report for the experiment workdir
